sections.text: Altus worked on lubricator and riser section. Meanwhile, schlumberger tested b/u equipment.
Held toolbox talk prior to lifting BOP to moonpool area.
Lifted BOP down to moonpool area. Spooled out hoses for BOP, HMV and DHSV to moonpool.
Attempted to feed cable head through lubricator. Unable to due to small id of x-over in lubricator.
Schlumberger disconnected bottom of cable head and fed cable through lubricator.
Connected GIH to lubricator section using tugger and catwalk. Spooled out and connected hoses to GIH. Meanwhile, schlumberger re-connected cable head and began signal test to equipment.
Waited while production department tested well barriers prior to handover.
Performed handover meeting between production and intervention. Verified valve status on XMT with production representant.
Held toolbox talk prior to lifting riser and lubricator section
Lifted and replaced permanent hatch with WL hatch.
Removed XMT top cap on well.
Lifted and connected lower riser to XMT.
Installed BOP on lower riser. Connected hoses to BOP and function tested same. Verified open close time.
Rigged up KWV manifold and bleed-off hoses on wellhead.
Lifted middle riser section and landed on top of BOP.
Held toolbox talk prior to lifting lubricator to middle riser.
Lifted lubricator and GIH to middle riser. Installed schlumberger dummy BHA in lubricator and stabbed onto middle riser.
Connected hoses for operating HMV and DHSV.
Filled lubricator with MEG from production department. Leak tested rig-up to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min.
Purged lubricator with n2.
Verified no liquid in rig-up prior to installing perforation BHA in well. Broke lubricator and l/d schlumberger dummy BHA.
Held toolbox talk prior to installing perforation BHA in well.
M/u BHA for perforation run 3/8'' PJN guns w/ 3 1/8'' tufftrac). Leak tested QTS to 20/345 bar 5/10 min. Dumped 40 l starlube in lubricator.
Opened HMV and pressurized DHSV control line.
